```audio
src: 'data:audio/mpeg;base64,AAAA'
title: '<script>HOSTILE_ATITLE()</script>'

```

```video
src: 'data:video/mp4;base64,AAAA'
poster: 'data:image/png;base64,AAAA" onerror="HOSTILE_POSTER()'

caption: '<script>HOSTILE_VCAPTION()</script>'
```
